findings.title: ROC is Arizona’s primary state-level company identity universe
findings.text: The official All Current Contractors posting-list header on 2026-09-02 reports 57,886 licenses. That is the current-posting universe, not 57,886 unique companies and not a recommendation.

findings.title: Senior added 2,776 state-native facility identities without minting thousands of new organizations
findings.text: Accepted AZ-SEN-001 ledger: 0 net-new canonical organizations, 2,776 state identities, 544 existing organizations enriched, 2,779 new evidence rows. Assisted Living Home is not Assisted Living Center is not a nursing home.

findings.title: HMDA covers all 15 Arizona counties with 308,338 2025 applications
findings.text: Specialist-owned: 183,374 originations and 49,721 denials (16.13%). HMDA is not a lender license census. Live DIFI/NMLS company roster remains search-only.

findings.title: 213 SEC/IARD firms report an Arizona principal office
findings.text: That is 1.18% of 17,997 roster firms with resolved geography. It is not the Arizona state-licensed adviser universe. ACC lists remain request-gated and were not filed.

findings.title: Arizona insurance business-entity bulk is paid through SBS
findings.text: Lookup is free. Generate a Report is $0.03 per row with a $30 minimum. This network does not publish a fake free Arizona agency denominator. Complete count is UNKNOWN.

findings.title: Arizona does not license household-goods movers
findings.text: Attorney General Mayes (2025-07-07): Arizona has no registration law or professional licensing requirement for movers. There is no state mover roster to acquire.
